title: Patch 25 - Massive Question Bank Expansion
description: Adds ~10,132 curated questions across core AFOQT subjects, normalizes part files to ~25 questions each, and documents the redistribution/admin review workflow.

contentRules.partSizing: Target ~25 questions per part file (occasionally up to 27 for completeness).
contentRules.overflowHandling: When a part exceeds the target size, split into sequential part<N> files while preserving subtopicId and difficulty.
contentRules.aggregation: All parts for the same (subtopicId, difficulty) are combined into a single in-memory pool during load.

redistributionNotes.reason: Original part1 files contained 50-77 questions; they were split to improve load time, memory use, and maintain consistency with Patch 18 expectations.
redistributionNotes.scope: Vocabulary, Math Knowledge, and Arithmetic Reasoning files were normalized to ~25-per-part with additional part files created as needed.
redistributionNotes.fileIntegrity: No questions were altered; only file boundaries changed.

adminReview.usage: Loads patch-loader only, lets reviewers filter by subject/subtopic/difficulty, and highlights correct answers and explanations without booting app.js.
adminReview.search: Supports text search across prompt and explanations for spot checks.

practiceTestGuidance.studyMode: Immediate feedback after each question (legacy behavior).
practiceTestGuidance.practiceTestMode: Hide feedback until completion, then show summary with overall score, breakdown by subject/subtopic/difficulty, missed items, and explanations at the end.
practiceTestGuidance.distribution: Use subject-specific difficulty distributions when constructing AFOQT practice tests; pool selection now benefits from the expanded part files.

validation.schema: Each file uses {subtopicId, difficulty, part, questions[]} with questions containing id/question/choices/answer/explanation.
validation.choices: choices must include keys A, B, C, D; answer matches one of the choice keys.
validation.explanations: Every question must include an explanation field; practiceTestMode hides until the summary screen.
